scp-049.title: Plague Doctor
scp-049.summary: A humanoid entity resembling a medieval plague doctor. It believes it can detect a mysterious 'Pestilence' and seeks to cure those it considers afflicted.

scp-096.title: The Shy Guy
scp-096.summary: A tall, pale humanoid that becomes extremely distressed when someone sees its face, whether directly or in an image.

scp-173.title: The Sculpture
scp-173.summary: An anomalous sculpture that can move when it is not being directly observed. Personnel must maintain visual contact during containment work.

scp-682.title: Hard-to-Destroy Reptile
scp-682.summary: A highly intelligent, aggressive reptilian entity known for extraordinary survival and adaptation. The Foundation has repeatedly attempted to neutralize it.

scp-999.title: The Tickle Monster
scp-999.summary: A friendly orange gelatinous creature with a playful temperament. Interactions with it are often associated with improved mood and reduced distress.
